title: Feedback lifecycle checker must not require started before a decision

outcomes.statement: A signed approval decision can be appended before work starts, so the readiness gate and the feedback lifecycle checker no longer contradict each other and pnpm test passes.
outcomes.demo: check-nous-feedback-order.mjs exits 0 on a log whose story has a decision before started, and still exits 1 when a genuine progress event precedes started.

uncertainties.statement: Whether exempting decision weakens the ordering guarantee for real progress events.
uncertainties.resolution: FEEDBACK.md's canonical vocabulary lists 'Decision (registered)' as its own category, separate from 'Lifecycle (flip story status)'. decision is already excluded from terminalEvents; only the blanket !state.started branch catches it. Exempting it restores agreement with the authoritative vocabulary and leaves every Lifecycle and Annotation event still ordered after started.
